title: Run the close-out's full suite under the gate's stripped git environment too
body:
The per-tick gate now measures CI's git environment (tick pqs, .tick/runners.toml `go` command), but only for the -short suite it runs. The full suite — where the end-to-end fixtures live, and where the lkd exit-128 instance actually was — still runs unstripped at close-out on a laptop with the developer's global git identity. Giving `make test` (harmless on CI, whose runners have no global gitconfig) the same env prefix would make close-out measure CI the same way the gate now does.
evidence: Makefile `test:` recipe vs the `gate:` recipe; .tick/runners.toml [testing.commands] go
